ipeds_api.title: NCES IPEDS fall 2024 admissions counts and nonresident-alien undergraduates (Urban Institute Education Data Portal)

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS fall 2024 (College Navigator percentages; exact counts from the NCES IPEDS ADM2024 file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal). SCAD does not publish a Common Data Set on the pages reviewed, so GPA, international applicants/admits and factors are not recorded. The 2,207 international undergraduates are IPEDS fall 2024 nonresident aliens (about 14% of 15,552). Percentiles come only from the 16% (SAT) and 12% (ACT) of enrolled students who submitted scores; SCAD is test-optional.
